title: Boatingo
source: clients/Adam/FY 2026 tech dev and R&D activity.pdf (Boatingo R&D summary, see clients/Adam/CHANGELOG.md)
features: Destination discovery (Fiji, Bali, Singapore, Palawan, Tahiti, Maldives, Phuket, Whitsundays)
Real-time availability synced from operator systems (Ankor, Nausys)
Search by date showing only boats with available capacity
Departure-time slots with live seats-left counts
Seat hold with countdown during payment (seats return if payment fails or times out)
Last-seat race handling - one booking wins, the other sees No seats available
Modify and cancel bookings, capacity released instantly
Operator / agent view: live sync status per source + block a boat

bottomTabBar.note: Exactly 4 tabs in this order, rounded outline icons: Explore=compass, Search=calendar-search, Bookings=ticket, Profile=user. Active tab graphite #2B2A28 icon+label with a small brass #D4B06A dot under it, inactive #8A8580. Flat white bar, hairline top border, no gradient.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Live availability pill reused on every listing/detail: small pill with pulsing green #16A34A dot + 'Live' + 'synced 12s ago' caption. Seats-left chip: brass tint fill, graphite text, e.g. '3 seats left'.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, graphite #2B2A28 fill, white label, pressed #1C1B1A, disabled #D9D5CF. Secondary: outline graphite 1.5px. Text input: 12px radius, white, hairline border #E7E3DD, focus = brass ring, error = danger ring. Card: 20px radius, white, soft shadow. Chip: pill, selected = graphite fill white text, unselected = #F1EEEA fill.
